reel.caption:
₹40,000 Diwali trip on LTA: is all of it tax-free?

LTA exempts only the travel fare: economy air, AC first-class rail or the bus fare, by the shortest route.
Hotel, food, cabs and sightseeing stay taxable. On an illustrative ₹40,000 trip with a ₹16,000 fare, ₹24,000 is taxed: about ₹4,992 at the 20% slab + 4% cess.
It's two journeys in a four-year block, and only in the old regime.

Are you claiming LTA on a trip this year?

Sources: two tax-filing guides on LTA rules (one updated Apr 2026); the ₹ figures are our own illustrative arithmetic.

For education only. Not investment advice.
